requirements.summary: All contracts, policies, procedures, software components, integrations, and operational processes that reference a Session **SHALL** use the meaning established by this contract.

requirements.summary: Every Session **SHALL** have: - `session_id` - `started_at`

requirements.summary: Every active Session **SHALL** have exactly one **Session Operator**.

requirements.summary: Detailed safety rules are outside the scope of this contract and SHALL be governed by applicable TSN DSS safety policies.

requirements.summary: Session Members SHALL respect operational instructions issued by the Session Operator when those instructions relate to safety, equipment, Observation integrity, or Session execution.
requirements.rationale: SessionMember persistence, permissions, and lifecycle were explicitly left out of Wave 9 correction scope and are not implemented in the repository.

requirements.summary: Session membership **SHALL NOT** imply ownership of any Project.
requirements.rationale: Existing tests prove part of this obligation, but not the full contract statement.

requirements.summary: Session membership **SHALL NOT** imply ownership of Captures, Frames, Datasets, ProcessingRuns, MosaicPlans, MosaicPanels, AcquisitionPlans, or other provenance or planning artifacts.
requirements.rationale: Existing tests prove part of this obligation, but not the full contract statement.

requirements.summary: No Session Member SHALL be required to understand provider architecture, telemetry schemas, MCP integrations, or other implementation details merely to look at the sky.
requirements.rationale: SessionMember experience and implementation-detail exposure are not implemented repository capabilities.

requirements.summary: A Session Member SHALL NOT automatically receive control over all Session systems.
requirements.rationale: SessionMember capability assignment is not implemented in the repository.

requirements.summary: The absence of a capability SHALL NOT prevent ordinary participation unless that capability is required for a specific action.
requirements.rationale: SessionMember participation and capability checks are not implemented in the repository.

requirements.summary: A Session Member without `equipment.control` SHALL NOT operate astronomical equipment merely because the equipment is physically accessible.
requirements.rationale: SessionMember equipment-control capability checks are not implemented in the repository.

requirements.summary: Session Members SHALL treat astronomical instruments, computers, sensors, power systems, and other Session equipment as operational equipment.
requirements.rationale: SessionMember equipment interaction behavior is not implemented in the repository.

requirements.summary: Unless explicitly authorized, Session Members SHALL NOT: - move or reposition an active Observation instrument, - disconnect power or communication links, - modify acquisition settings, - interrupt an active Observation, - alter Session software configuration, - handle equipment in a way that may compromise safety or data acquisition.
requirements.rationale: SessionMember authorization and equipment operation behavior are not implemented in the repository.

requirements.summary: Unintentional light exposure SHALL be treated as an operational inconvenience, not as grounds for summary execution of the Session Member.
requirements.rationale: Policy or governance statement; no repository-level behavior is required or sufficient for full verification in this wave.

requirements.summary: Session Members SHALL take reasonable care not to contaminate, damage, obstruct, or destabilize operational equipment.
requirements.rationale: SessionMember field-equipment behavior is not implemented in the repository.

requirements.summary: Junior Session Members SHALL NOT receive unrestricted equipment-control capabilities by default.
requirements.rationale: Junior SessionMember capability behavior is not implemented in the repository.

requirements.summary: Every Session Member SHALL prioritize personal and group safety over Session objectives.
requirements.rationale: Policy or governance statement; no repository-level behavior is required or sufficient for full verification in this wave.

requirements.summary: SHALL be considered valid environmental input and MAY justify immediate reassessment by the Session Operator.
requirements.rationale: Policy or governance statement; no repository-level behavior is required or sufficient for full verification in this wave.

requirements.summary: When an emergency, credible hazard, or Session abort condition is declared, Session Members SHALL prioritize movement to the designated safe location and follow reasonable safety instructions from the Session Operator.
requirements.rationale: Policy or governance statement; no repository-level behavior is required or sufficient for full verification in this wave.
